statement.zh: 教科文将拉帕努伊国家公园列入世界遗产，强调波利尼西亚纪念性石雕与礼仪景观（UNESCO 715）。
statement.en: UNESCO lists Rapa Nui National Park as World Heritage, emphasizing Polynesian monumental stone sculpture and ritual landscape (UNESCO 715).

statement.zh: Van Tilburg 1994 综合复活节岛考古，强调摩艾研究与保护伦理（Oxford / related presses）。
statement.en: Van Tilburg 1994 synthesizes Easter Island archaeology with emphasis on moai research and conservation ethics (Oxford / related presses).

statement.zh: Hunt & Lipo 2011 等提出与“生态崩溃”叙事竞争的拓殖、大鼠与资源模型（争议性 S 级综合）。
statement.en: Hunt & Lipo 2011 and related work propose colonization, rat, and resource models competing with 'ecocide' narratives (contested S-tier synthesis).

statement.zh: 拉诺拉拉库被表述为主要摩艾采石场，见教科文与 Van Tilburg 综合（UNESCO 715；Van Tilburg 1994）。
statement.en: Rano Raraku is framed as the primary moai quarry in UNESCO and Van Tilburg syntheses (UNESCO 715; Van Tilburg 1994).

statement.zh: 阿胡东加里基是修复后的多摩艾滨海祭坛，见于教科文景观描述（UNESCO 715；Van Tilburg）。
statement.en: Ahu Tongariki is a restored multi-moai coastal platform in UNESCO landscape descriptions (UNESCO 715; Van Tilburg).

statement.zh: 奥龙戈与鸟人教礼仪景观见于 Routledge 记述与教科文公园描述（Routledge 1919；UNESCO 715）。
statement.en: Orongo and birdman ritual landscape appear in Routledge's account and UNESCO park descriptions (Routledge 1919; UNESCO 715).

statement.zh: Lipo & Hunt 等发表摩艾“行走”运输实验假说，属于争议性技术史讨论（article orientation）。
statement.en: Lipo & Hunt and collaborators publish 'walking' moai transport experimental hypotheses as contested technical-history discussion.

statement.zh: 普纳保作为红色火山渣顶髻（pukao）采石场出现在综合描述中（Van Tilburg 1994；UNESCO 715）。
statement.en: Puna Pau appears in syntheses as the red scoria pukao quarry (Van Tilburg 1994; UNESCO 715).

statement.zh: 本包对外媒体仅用教科文/机构文档外链，不托管摩艾文物图像，以符合伦理优先立场（coverage-map / shell notes）。
statement.en: This pack uses outbound UNESCO/institutional document links only and hosts no moai artifact images, per ethics-first stance (coverage-map / shell notes).

statement.zh: Stevenson 等研究传统讨论拉帕努伊年代学与农业景观（orientation source in shell）。
statement.en: Stevenson and related research traditions discuss Rapa Nui chronology and agricultural landscapes (orientation source in shell).
